routes.assumes: the residual is a smooth spatial field with NO flight-line term, so 963 marks anywhere inform this site
routes.fails_if: the per-line structure is real (measured: F = 8.63, p < 0.001), in which case this averages across lines that genuinely differ

routes.assumes: only the site's own flight-line PASSES carry its datum; a line has one constant along its length
routes.fails_if: a line's constant drifts along track (tested: slope +0.74 +/- 2.37 mm/km, and 15.5 mm/km excluded at 6.23 sigma), or 7 marks are too few

routes.assumes: same, but point_source_id names a line -- which it does not
